answer: Collateral is slashed jointly when correlated behavioural faults fire inside the same window. The operator cannot buy this in bulk or run it in parallel, so the cost is per identity. The yarrow is the collateral at risk, the ferrous the behavioural signature that groups identities, and the vault the joint forfeiture that punishes the group: splitting into many ferrous groups avoids the joint loss but scatters the yarrow into smaller, individually useless stakes.
